findings.problem: When switching to the DRIVER role, the top sub-navigation tab bar inside FieldOperationsView still displays workstation tabs (Loading Weighbridge, Unloading Weighbridge, Supervision Board) alongside the Driver view.
findings.userImpact: A truck driver can see and select weighbridge scale operator controls intended for scale operators, causing visual noise and potential operational confusion.
findings.recommendedMinimalFix: Restrict sub-tab navigation header buttons in FieldOperationsView when currentRole is DRIVER, rendering only the Driver view.

findings.problem: In clean runtime state (0 projects/carriers/trucks/drivers), the empty state callout card displays informational notice, but the primary 'Add Record' action is positioned in the top-right header toolbar.
findings.userImpact: Slight friction for first-time project administrators discovering how to populate the initial carrier or truck entry.
findings.recommendedMinimalFix: Add a prominent direct action button ('إضافة كيان جديد') inside the empty state callout card when entity list length is zero.

findings.problem: On narrow phone viewports (< 380px width), the 5 multi-select filter controls stack vertically, pushing the 'Export CSV / PDF' action buttons below the fold.
findings.userImpact: Requires extra vertical scrolling on small mobile devices to reach export controls after filtering.
findings.recommendedMinimalFix: Collapse secondary filter inputs into an expandable 'Filter Options' accordion on viewports smaller than 640px.

findings.problem: System tool badge color variants (blue, emerald, amber, rose) vary across tools without a visible color key.
findings.userImpact: Minor visual inconsistency in developer and system tool badge rendering.
findings.recommendedMinimalFix: Standardize badge color variants to slate/neutral or provide consistent domain-based color rules across system tools.

sectionSummaries.navigation: Role-based navigation accurately filters tabs across all 9 authoritative roles (SUPER_ADMIN, PROJECT_ADMIN, SUPERVISOR, SITE_SUPERVISOR, DISPATCHER, SCALE_OPERATOR, FINANCE_AUDITOR, DRIVER, VIEWER). Mobile drawer provides accessible >= 44px touch targets and clear section grouping.
sectionSummaries.fieldUsability: Field operations follow the IDENTIFY -> CAPTURE -> VALIDATE -> ACT -> CONFIRM workflow. Weighbridge forms feature auto-calculated net weights, clear variance highlights, and minimal typing click-to-select inputs. Driver view prioritizes QR code and active trip details.
sectionSummaries.projectsMasterData: Clean runtime state is handled gracefully with clear empty state cards. Project creation wizard steps (1-7) are intuitive for authorized roles.
sectionSummaries.reportsDashboard: Executive Dashboard and Field Reports Engine maintain strict separation between financial settlements and operational metrics. Filter bars, charts, and drill-down drawers function smoothly.
sectionSummaries.responsive: Layouts scale fluidly across phone (<640px), tablet (640-1024px), and desktop (>1024px) viewports without horizontal clipping, missing controls, or broken modal dialogs.
sectionSummaries.rtlLtr: Strict RTL/LTR support verified. Arabic and Urdu render RTL with correctly mirrored icons and alignment. English renders LTR. I18N key count remains frozen at 1,128 per locale.
sectionSummaries.accessibility: Semantic HTML elements, visible focus borders, WCAG AA readable contrast, and >= 44px touch targets on primary operational controls are maintained across all screens.
sectionSummaries.visualConsistency: Unified industrial dark/light aesthetic palette with consistent typography, pill border-radii (capped at 12-16px), and status colors across cards and tables.
